mapper.select: SELECT t2.register_status AS registerStatus, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM t_as_student_identity t1 LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.* FROM t_as_student s INNER JOIN ( SELECT s1.student_identity_id, MAX(s1.create_time) AS max_time FROM t_as_student s1 GROUP BY s1.student_identity_id ) t_max ON s.student_identity_id = t_max.student_identity_id AND s.create_time = t_max.max_time ) t2 ON t1.id = t2.student_identity_id INNER JOIN t_educl_term te ON te.id = t2.term_id AND te.is_valid = 1 WHERE t1.is_valid = 1 AND t1.school_id = #{schoolId} GROUP BY t2.register_status

SELECT DISTINCT stu.id AS studentId, gs.guardian_user_id AS userId FROM t_as_student stu INNER JOIN t_as_guardian_student gs on gs.student_identity_id = stu.student_identity_id and gs.is_valid = 1 and bind_status = 1 WHERE stu.is_valid = 1 and stu.register_status = 1 and gs.guardian_user_id is not NULL AND stu.school_id = #{schoolId} AND stu.id IN
#{id}
